title: observability: introduce wireflow token-cost cohort and attribution trellis
author: Maya Chen
description: Motivation: long-tail invocation cost/latency signals are noisy and siloed between token-level billing metrics and kernel/runtime latency slices. This PR adds a lightweight wireflow tracer that stitches token cohorts (by prompt shape and prefix warmup state) to kernel-level latency slices and produces an attribution trellis consumable by dashboards and alerting. Goals: 1) surface which token cohorts are driving cost spikes at the kernel/batching level, 2) enable low-noise alerts that combine cohort-level delta and kernel contention signals, 3) provide a tenant-aware trellis dashboard for SREs/Platform to triage cost regressions without deep trace joins. Changes are split across runtime instrumentation, a small aggregation sidecar, metric rollups, and a Grafana dashboard. Notable design points: the wireflow tracer emits a concise span (wireflow.token_slice) with attributes {cohort_id, kernel_hint, kv_warm, batch_size_hint, tenant_id, token_cost_est}. Cohort assignment is probabilistic and low-overhead (1% default) and is configurable by deployment. The aggregation sidecar consumes these spans, produces cohort histograms, and emits compact rollups: wireflow.cohort.cost_p50/95, wireflow.cohort.kernel_latency_p50/95, and wireflow.cohort.contention_index. The dashboard uses a trellis layout: rows = tenant, columns = cohort; panels include compact heatmap of per-token-cost delta, stacked kernel-latency waterfall, and a ranked callsite attribution list. Alerting: new rule wireflow_high_delta combines cohort.cost_p95 delta > 3x baseline AND cohort.contention_index > 0.2; it suppresses noisy one-off invocations by requiring sustained delta over a 30m window. Rollout: feature-gated, disabled by default on hosted; enabled for Dedicated trial clusters and Private via installer flag. Backfill: a backfill script is provided to derive cohort baselines from 7 days of sampled spans. See release_notes for operator-facing notes.

release_notes: Introduces wireflow tracer and aggregation pipeline to correlate token-cost cohorts with kernel-level latency slices. Adds Grafana Trellis dashboard, two alerting rules (wireflow_high_delta, wireflow_sustained_contention), and a backfill tool for baseline computation. Feature-gated; disabled on hosted by default. Operators: review sidecar memory/capacity knobs and enable sampling only where sample-storage/backfill is acceptable. Notable metric names: wireflow.cohort.cost_p50, wireflow.cohort.cost_p95, wireflow.cohort.kernel_latency_p50, wireflow.cohort.contention_index.
notes_for_ops: Default sampling: 1% per-invocation, configurable in pkg/config/defaults.go; sidecar soft-limit: 1k cohorts/shard, hard-limit triggers drop and metric wireflow.aggregator.drops; use charts/wireflow/values.yaml to tune in Dedicated/Private. Backfill duration: 7 days recommended; backfill script writes baselines into telemetry/migrations table for alert calibration.
additional_context: This PR is part of a series addressing noisy cost alerts for long-tail invocations (see ENG-2468). It is intentionally conservative in sampling to limit telemetry volume but provides configuration to ramp up for customer debugging. Follow-up work: add cohort-aware SLO decomposition and a compact storage format for cohort histograms (ENG-2560).
